data.name: Narayani
data.long_meaning: Narayani is the name of the goddess who is the consort of Vishnu, the preserver god in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Vishnu's shakti, or divine energy. The name Narayani comes from the word 'Narayana', which means 'the one who rests in water'. As the goddess of Gods, Narayani is the embodiment of compassion, love, and nurturing energy.
